title: The Tech view description, and Tech view stays disabled until a Work orders permission is on
custom_preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role).
custom_steps:
1. In a blank editor, note whether the Tech view option can be selected.
  2. Turn on a Work orders permission (for example View).
  3. Select Tech view and read its description.
custom_expected:
In a blank editor the Tech view option is disabled until a Work orders permission is turned on.

After turning on Work orders View, Tech view can be selected and shows the description: 'Simplified interface focused on the technician workflow. Non-essential fields are hidden to reduce clutter, and only the actions a technician needs day-to-day are shown.'
viu_status: Verified-Label (Tech view text build-verified); disabled-state needs live check
evidence: Tech view description string confirmed verbatim in build (WoSettingsRow). Disabled-until-WO-perm needs live editor.
